description: This PHP source file defines the ResetPasswordService class responsible for handling password reset functionalities within the OrangeHRM system, including generating reset codes, validating reset requests, sending reset emails, and updating user passwords.

classes.name: ResetPasswordService
classes.description: A service class providing functionalities for reset password workflows, including code generation, validation, email notification, and password update.

methods.name: getEmailService
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmailService, creating one if it does not exist.

methods.name: getResetPasswordDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of ResetPasswordDao, creating one if it does not exist.

methods.name: hasPasswordResetRequestNotExpired
methods.description: Calculates the number of days elapsed since the password reset request was made.

methods.name: extractPasswordResetMetaData
methods.description: Decodes the reset code and extracts associated metadata.

methods.name: generateEmailBody
methods.description: Generates an email body from a template file, replacing placeholders with given replacements.

methods.name: searchForUserRecord
methods.description: Searches for a user record by username, verifying account status and employee association.

methods.name: generatePasswordResetEmailBody
methods.description: Creates the email body for password reset instructions with a reset link.

methods.name: sendPasswordResetCodeEmail
methods.description: Sends a password reset email to the user's work email if valid.

methods.name: generatePasswordResetCode
methods.description: Generates a unique password reset code encoded with the username and random bytes.

methods.name: validateUser
methods.description: Validates user object ensuring the account is active and not terminated.

methods.name: validateUrl
methods.description: Validates reset code URL, including expiration and correctness, and retrieves linked user.

methods.name: logPasswordResetRequest
methods.description: Logs a password reset request, generating a code and emailing the user.

methods.name: saveResetPassword
methods.description: Updates the user's password after validation, inside a transaction.
